name: Frosthowl
fuse: Scorchhowl's standing wolf body, fierce face, dark grey fur and the white X mark on its chest; Glynsera's icy blue fur and sharp crystal ice blades along the arms, back and tail; one shoulder burning with orange flames and the other covered in ice crystals

name: Coralgon
fuse: Infergon's black armored dragon body, sharp horns, big pointed wings and glowing cracks on the chest; Coraliz's branching pink coral antlers and its soft pink-red frills along the neck and back; the glowing cracks turn coral pink

name: Fulmignis
fuse: Fulmintis's tall white and gold armored mantis-knight body, its golden antler crest and blade arms; Ignitis's sleek purple armor plates, long thin antennae and sharp red eyes; colours white, gold and purple

name: Blazquash
fuse: Squashel's fluffy orange squirrel body, big fluffy tail, cute face and green scarf; Blazen's huge spiky yellow electric mane around the head and shoulders and the yellow fur stripes on its arms; small sparks in the fur

name: Hypnowl
fuse: Hypnyto's fluffy white and blue cat body, long fluffy tail and big purple eyes; Mesmerowl's round owl face, ear-feather tufts and soft blue owl wings on the back; colours white, light blue and purple

name: Fenlupa
fuse: Inferlupa's dark purple wolf body, fierce face and blue spirit flame on its tail; Fenmane's big fluffy white fox mane around the neck, its golden ear tufts and fluffy white paws; colours dark purple, white and gold

name: Magmabask
fuse: Crocobask's long crocodile body, big wide jaws and short legs; Magmarex's dark volcanic rock skin with glowing orange lava cracks and the lava spikes along its back; a patch of green moss on the head like Crocobask

name: Whirlburst
fuse: Whirlbite's shark head with big jaws, blue and white colours and lightning stripes; Jeburst's long white-blue dragon neck and body, its orange-tipped head fins and wing membranes on the forelimbs

name: Stellinelle
fuse: Stellarys's small purple body, big witch hat and glowing star badge; Luminelle's glowing mushroom cap shape on the witch hat, its warm yellow glow and long ribbon-like legs; colours purple, yellow and light blue

name: Thornpaw
fuse: Pawney's armored knight body, dark blue-grey armor and its sword; Thornblade's red leafy head crest, green leaf blades on the arms and red scarf; colours dark blue, green and red

name: Sugarbit
fuse: Scrubbit's round happy frog body, big smiling face and green leaf skirt; Sugarslime's pink jelly body texture, the swirl of cream and sprinkles on top of the head like an ice cream; colours pink, cream and green

name: Helfergon
fuse: Helgon's tall steel-grey armored dragon body and big bat-like wings; Infergon's black armor, sharp horns and glowing red-orange cracks across the chest and wings; colours steel grey, black and glowing red
